#### Graphite India Limited

Graphite India Limited (GIL) is the pioneer in India for manufacture of Graphite Electrodes as well
as Carbon and Graphite Speciality products. GIL’s manufacturing facilities are spread across 6
plants in India.

#### History

Having started in 1967 in collaboration with erstwhile Great Lakes Carbon Corporation (GLCC) of USA,
GIL has been continually improving its product quality and services thereby scaling newer heights of
excellence and customer recognition. This journey has been fueled by our reliance on cutting-edge
technology, a natural penchant for innovation and creativity, eco-friendly approach in production
process, consistency of product quality and services as well as productivity and cost optimization.

### Chairman's Message

Since its inception in the 1960s, **Graphite India Limited (GIL)** has grown from a modest **5,000
MT** capacity to **98,000 MT** of graphite electrodes. This remarkable journey marked by challenges,
innovations, and achievements has shaped GIL into a globally respected and responsible corporate
entity.

While **graphite electrodes** remain our core strength, our diverse product portfolio extends far
beyond. We specialize in **Impervious Graphite Equipment, Graphite Specialty Products, High-Speed
Steel, Calcined Petroleum Coke,** and **Renewable Energy Solutions** spanning **solar, wind, and
hydropower generation**. Our strategic investment in a **U.S.-based company** for **Graphene Sheet
production **and **battery chemicals technology **opens exciting new avenues for growth and
innovation.

 Read More

At GIL, we prioritize **attracting, nurturing, and retaining top talent** while continuously
enhancing our expertise to stay ahead of industry advancements. Our success is driven by **strategic
investments in new products, cutting-edge technologies, and sustainability initiatives **ensuring we
remain agile in a rapidly evolving market.

With an unwavering commitment to **cost optimization, quality enhancement, and performance
excellence**, we operate with a philosophy of **strategic thinking, adaptability, and proactive
market responsiveness**. This enables us to **create value, fulfill customer commitments, and
safeguard stakeholder interests**.

As we move forward, we remain dedicated to **excellence in Carbon and Graphite**, staying true to
our legacy while embracing the future.

## Wer wir sind

#### Die SGL Carbon ist ein technologiebasiertes und eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen bei
#### der Entwicklung und Herstellung von **kohlenstoffbasierten Lösungen**. Unsere Materialien und
#### Produkte aus [**Spezialgraphit**][96], [**Carbonfasern**][97] und **Verbundwerkstoffen**
#### bedienen viele Industrien, die die Trends der Zukunft bestimmen: klimaschonende Mobilität,
#### Halbleitertechnik, LED, Solar- und Windenergie sowie die Herstellung von Brennstoffzellen und
#### anderen Energiespeichersystemen.
#### Auch für die Chemiebranche und zahlreiche industrielle Anwendungen entwickeln wir Lösungen, die
#### zukunftsweisend und zuverlässig zugleich sind. Es ist unser Antrieb, mit Produkten und
#### Technologien zu wachsen, die der Gesellschaft zugutekommen und Umweltbelastungen reduzieren.
#### Mit rund **3.800 Mitarbeitenden** an **28 Standorten** in Europa, Nordamerika und Asien haben
#### wir im Geschäftsjahr 2025 einen Umsatz von **850 Millionen Euro** erzielt.

## About Us

Part of the challenge to meet demand for high quality products and increased production is keeping
operating costs low. Choosing the right oil for your various applications is also becoming
increasingly difficult. Standard oils may work, but don’t always provide the most efficient answers
to your machining and lubricant needs. That’s why many manufacturers are turning to Acme Refining
for help. We work personally with each of our customers to develop the best oil to match your
requirements.

## Support

Our business goes beyond simply selling a custom blend to our customers. When you choose Acme
Refining for your chemical solutions needs, you also get help down the line in the form of our
technical support and field service.

## Standard of Conduct

Acme Refining takes pride in its devotion to its customers. We have a proven track record of
excellent customer service, and we constantly strive to deliver the fastest delivery and response
times as possible. We give personal attention to every order and work with our customers to find the
best product for their application.

## FTSE AIM Market By Numbers

A lot has changed since the inception of the FTSE AIM Market in 1995. The [figures on the success of
AIM][7] quoted companies speak for themselves.

£0bnCOMBINED MARKET CAP
In 1995, AIM launched with ten companies valued at £82m. AIM is home to ~850 companies with a
combined market cap of £104bn.*
£0bnDAILY TRADE VOLUME
In its first full year of trading, the daily volume of trades of AIM companies averaged 21.9m. In
2019, it was 2.4bn.
£0bnFUNDS RAISED
Since 1995, over 3,865 AIM-listed companies have raised over £115bn on the AIM Market.
£0mAVERAGE MONEY RAISED
The average amount of money raised by companies during the first five years of AIM was £2.8m. During
the past five years it has been £21.4m.

operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

### Coatings

Our water-based coatings for packaging and converting are very useful in improving functional
properties such as high scuff, water, grease, and oil resistance.

Learn More ][19] [

### Adhesives

Our multi-purpose, water- based adhesives can be used for a wide variety of industrial applications.

Learn More ][20] [

### Additives

Our water-based additives are formulated to improve flow, laydown and surface properties of inks,
coatings and adhesives. They are also helpful in the reduction of foam.

Learn More ][21] [

### Primers

Our water-based extrusion laminating primers have been in commercial use for over 40 years. They are
used for packaging PE, PP film, paper and foil to a wide variety of accepting substrates.

Learn More ][22]

## Innovative Solutions

For over 50 years, industrial converters around the world rely on our water-based formulations to
produce millions of reams of film-to-film, foil, and paper extrusions and laminations. We are your
business partner for all of your coatings, extrusion laminating primers, adhesives and ink additive
needs.

### Rohstoffexperte seit über 100 Jahren

Europa und Asien für herausragende Rohstoffkompetenz. Auf Basis moderner Prozesse garantieren wir
höchste Qualität – vom Rohstoff bis zur maßgeschneiderten Lösung, die wir im Dialog mit unseren
Kunden entwickeln. Eine ausgeprägte Forschungsarbeit sichert die kontinuierliche Optimierung unseres
Produktportfolios. Die AMG Graphite betreibt am Firmenhauptsitz im niederbayerischen Hauzenberg eine
eigene Mine und hält Beteiligungen an Graphitminen in Sri Lanka. Seit 2008 gehört die AMG Graphite
zur AMG Critical Materials N.V. und hat als global tätige Expertin für kritische Rohstoffe die Nase

gefragt wie nie! Ob makrokristalliner Flockengraphit, mikrokristalliner bzw. amorpher Graphit oder

## GRAPHIT KROPFMÜHL

### Rohstoffexperte seit über 100 Jahren

Seit ihrer Gründung vor mehr als hundert Jahren steht die AMG Graphite mit Produktionsstandorten in
Europa und Asien für herausragende Rohstoffkompetenz. Auf Basis moderner Prozesse garantieren wir
höchste Qualität – vom Rohstoff bis zur maßgeschneiderten Lösung, die wir im Dialog mit unseren
Kunden entwickeln. Eine ausgeprägte Forschungsarbeit sichert die kontinuierliche Optimierung unseres
Produktportfolios. Die AMG Graphite betreibt am Firmenhauptsitz im niederbayerischen Hauzenberg eine
eigene Mine und hält Beteiligungen an Graphitminen in Sri Lanka. Seit 2008 gehört die AMG Graphite
zur AMG Critical Materials N.V. und hat als global tätige Expertin für kritische Rohstoffe die Nase
vorn, wenn es um Technologien und Hochwertprodukte zur Reduzierung von CO2-Emissionen geht.

[ Über uns ][156]

## Produkte

### Pulver


Weil seine Anwendungen in Zukunftstechnologien vielfältig und die Rohstoffvorkommen auf wenige
Lieferländer begrenzt sind, zählt Graphit zu den weltweit kritischen Rohstoffen. Naturgraphit ist
gefragt wie nie! Ob makrokristalliner Flockengraphit, mikrokristalliner bzw. amorpher Graphit oder
hochreiner Vein-Graphit: Dank eigener Rohstoffquellen in Kropfmühl und Sri Lanka sowie verschiedener
Produktionsverfahren kann AMG Graphite Naturgraphit mit unterschiedlichen Eigenschaften anbieten und
führt überdies sekundär synthetischen Graphit in ihrem Sortiment.

[ Mehr ][157]

## Produkte

### Dispersionen


Aus unserem umfangreichen Graphitsortiment wählen wir die passenden Sorten für unsere Dispersionen
aus – je nachdem, wofür sie später verwendet werden. Indem wir an unserem Standort Kropfmühl
fertigen, können wir die Dispersionen flexibel und auf die Anforderungen unserer Kunden abgestimmt
herstellen. Dazu stellen wir zunächst Pulvermischungen her: Ausgewählte Graphite werden mit
funktionellen organischen und anorganischen Dispergieradditiven im Tonnenmaßstab vermischt. Das
macht unsere Produkte homogener und leichter reproduzierbar.

# [GrapheneOS][13]

The private and secure mobile operating system with Android app compatibility. Developed as a
non-profit open source project.

[Install GrapheneOS][14]

Get to know GrapheneOS

## [About][15]

GrapheneOS is a privacy and security focused mobile OS with Android app compatibility developed as a
non-profit [open source][16] project. It's focused on the research and development of privacy and
security technology including substantial improvements to sandboxing, exploit mitigations and the
permission model. It was founded in 2014 and was [formerly known as CopperheadOS][17].

GrapheneOS improves the privacy and security of the OS from the bottom up. It deploys technologies
to mitigate whole classes of vulnerabilities and make exploiting the most common sources of
vulnerabilities substantially more difficult. It improves the security of both the OS and the apps
running on it. The app sandbox and other security boundaries are fortified. GrapheneOS tries to
avoid impacting the user experience with the privacy and security features. Ideally, the features
can be designed so that they're always enabled with no impact on the user experience and no
additional complexity like configuration options. It's not always feasible, and GrapheneOS does add
various toggles for features like the Network permission, Sensors permission, restrictions when the
device is locked (USB-C and pogo pins, camera, quick tiles), etc. along with more complex
user-facing privacy and security features with their own UX.

The [features page][18] provides an overview of the substantial privacy and security improvements
added by GrapheneOS to the Android Open Source Project (AOSP). Many of our past features were
[contributed to AOSP, Linux and other projects to improve privacy and security for billions of
users][19] so they're no longer listed on our features page.

Official releases are available on the [releases page][20] and installation instructions are on the
[install page][21].

GrapheneOS also develops various apps and services with a focus on privacy and security. Vanadium is
a hardened variant of the Chromium browser and WebView specifically built for GrapheneOS. GrapheneOS
also includes our minimal security-focused PDF Viewer, our hardware-based Auditor app providing
local and remote verification and attestation of devices, our modern privacy and security focused
camera app, and the externally developed Seedvault encrypted backup which was initially developed
for inclusion in GrapheneOS.

## [No Google apps or services][22]

GrapheneOS will never include either Google Play services or another implementation of Google
services like microG. It's possible to install Play services as a set of fully sandboxed apps
without special privileges via our [sandboxed Google Play compatibility layer][23]. See [the FAQ
section][24] for more details on our plans for filling in the gaps from not shipping Play services
and Google apps.

## [Device support][25]

See [the FAQ section on device support][26].

# Your procedural toolbox for 2D content creation

Graphite is a free, open source vector graphics editor and animation engine, available now in alpha.
Get creative with a fully nondestructive editing workflow that combines layer-based compositing with
node-based generative design.

# Software overview

Starting life as a vector editor, Graphite is evolving into a general-purpose, all-in-one graphics
toolbox that is built more like a game engine than a conventional creative app. The editor's tools
wrap its node graph core, exposing user-friendly workflows for vector, raster, animation, and
beyond.

## One app to rule them all

Stop jumping between programs. Upcoming tools will make Graphite a first-class content creation
suite for many workflows, including:

Graphic Design
Motion Graphics
Image Editing
Digital Painting
Page Layout & Print
VFX Compositing

## Current features

Vector editing tools
Procedural workflow for graphic design
Node-based layers
Forever free and open source

Presently, Graphite is a lightweight offline web app with features primarily oriented around
procedural vector graphics editing.

## Upcoming features

All-in-one creative tool for all things 2D
Fully-featured raster manipulation
Windows/Mac/Linux native apps + web
Live collaborative editing

# NYACOL® Nano Technologies, Inc. is a leading producer of inorganic fine particle materials.

NYACOL® Nano Technologies, Inc. is a leading producer of inorganic fine particle materials. We
specialize in the development and manufacture of sub-200-nanometer (nm) metal oxide materials as
water-based colloidal sols, hydrocarbon-based colloidal dispersions, fine-particle powders, polymer
concentrates and dispersions. Our products have diverse applications in catalysts, flame retardants,
PET film and bottles, and more. From NYACOL's location in Ashland, Massachusetts, we provide
practical, affordable, cutting-edge technology solutions that give our customers a market edge. Our
international presence-with [a team of representatives all over the globe][47]-ensures they receive
first-rate tech support and service.

Nubrikon is pleased to be a highly effective technology solution for problem-solving metalworking
products. Nubrikon supplies not only the most technically innovative high temperature products, but
also provides unmatched customer service and single-point accountability, all at a competitive
price. This website is designed to help you learn about the many high tech lubricating products we
offer.

Nubrikon focuses solely on the implementation and use of technology to meet the severe operating
conditions found in the metal melting and metal forming industry today. Nubrikon is a leading
provider of high temperature lubricants to all sections of commercial and manufacturing fields,
providing many new and innovative forging lubricants used throughout the world.

Nubrikon’s forging lubricants for the ferrous and non-ferrous markets provide unequaled performance,
with or without graphite. Our specialty greases for forging press gears, bearings, chains and cables
give superior protection while being sensitive to the environment. The die casting release agents,
ceramic cements and release coatings, and graphitic mold release coatings are also among the
technology solutions provided by Nubrikon.
